about: Approximate map position for each river, keyed by Vassdragsnr_hovedvassdrag. NOT sampling sites and not necessarily the river mouth: each point is one representative point on the river taken from Kartverket's place-name register (Sentralt stedsnavnregister, https://ws.geonorge.no/stedsnavn/v1), picked by hand where the name is ambiguous. Expect up to a few tens of km from the outlet on long rivers. `from` records which register object was used.

030.4Z.from: Espedalsvatnet (Vann, Sandnes) - the lake Espedalselva drains; no Rogaland river object by that name in the register

083.Z.from: Gaula (Elv, Sogndal/Sunnfjord) - the full Gaularvassdraget object

107.3Z.from: Sylteelva (Elv, Hustadvika) - Sylteelva and Moaelva are ~3 km apart there

170.5Z.from: Varpelva (Elv, Hamarøy) - sits with Varpvatnet and Varpvågen; the other 'Varpa' objects are sounds, not a river

178.6Z.from: Gårdselva (Elv, Andøy) - ~6 km from Teinvatnet/Buksnes, matching the adjacent numbers 178.6/178.7

178.7Z.from: Teinvatnet (Tjern, Andøy) - ~2 km from Buksnes gard and Buksnesfjorden; the river's source lake

186.2Z.from: Åelva (Elv, Andøy) - the only Åelva on Andøy, ~10 km from Roksdalen

194.Z.from: Lakselva (Elv, Senja) - the one ~1.4 km from Trollbuvatnet
